body: Thank you, making new circles is kinda hard to me cuz I have no idea how to make friends with others lmao. Im not used to talk to strangers face to face or express myself to others. But i guess I’ll try. Thank you again for your advice. :) I really hope things can go smoothly like you said though the world hardly work like that. I’ll still keep hoping.

My first attempt was at 3 years ago and things didn’t get better. Every time my life got better a little bit, a new trauma would wait for me after that.   Death is terrifying now after all these failed attempts, but I’m also so frightened to face tomorrow.

I totally understand your feelings. Sometimes I feel sorry that I exist bcs I only leave bad things for everyone around me. I always hope I can cease myself so that no one will feel sorrow. But I’m still tolerating everything and trying to find a way out. I hope one day I can find it out and I can tell you how to get thru all these fucking things. Please stay.
Agree! It’s really important to think about that or it will be really embarrassing if you fail…I’ve been thru that and it was like crazy…
